legend: Pancreatic duct brushing cytopathology shows a cohesive tissue fragment of ductal epithelial cells with mild disorganization, nuclear crowding, and mild nuclear atypia in a clean background (Pap).

Pancreatic duct brushing cytopathology shows tissue fragments of mildly atypical epithelium with increased cellularity, nuclear pseudostratification, and nuclear irregularities (liquid-based cytopathology, Pap).
